title: Tracking: Native/Desktop sovereign frame driver and display refresh integration
symptoms: On non-WASM / native platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux, Blitz desktop), animations do not advance automatically because no sovereign display-link or winit event-loop frame driver is active. Current runtime falls back to ManualDriver requiring explicit motion.tick(dt).
cause: Dioxus Desktop and Blitz currently lack a standardized, cross-platform public Rust animation frame hook/clock tied to OS V-Sync (macOS CVDisplayLink, Windows DwmFlush, Wayland presentation time, or winit RedrawRequested). Upstream oxidase also returns FrameLoopError::RuntimeUnavailable on native.
solution: 1) Monitor upstream oxidase native frame loop resolution (tracked in oxidase ISSUE-0001) and Blitz winit redraw cycle hook capabilities. 2) Implement NativeDriver in kinetoxus replacing ManualDriver when a sovereign host frame loop becomes available. 3) Preserve ManualDriver for deterministic unit/integration testing while activating NativeDriver automatically in windowed environments.
